profile.org_note: First America Homes is the homebuilding division of The Signorelli Company, a vertically integrated private developer at 1401 Woodlands Pkwy, The Woodlands (parent main line 713-452-1700). Land and finance decisions sit at the parent: the Land division (Jeff Dewese, President, Land; Chase Moore, VP Land Acquisition; Ragan Robinson, Director of Investments) and the parent CFO (Harry Dinham). The builder is run by President John Winniford with division presidents in Houston and San Antonio; no Dallas-Fort Worth or Austin division head is published.
profile.summary: Texas-only, conventional for-sale builder owned by private developer The Signorelli Company. It closed 750 homes in 2025 (540 in 2024), runs about 30 active communities in Houston and San Antonio, entered Dallas-Fort Worth and Austin in mid-2026, and states a goal of 5,000 homes a year by 2035. Lots come partly from the parent's own land arm (the parent cites 25,000+ paper lots) and, in the new markets, from finished homesites bought in other developers' communities, so the land and capital conversation is with the parent's land and finance team.
